value_leaf_table.derivation: PLAY SCALARS use only in-play depths (<= h_conv_depth_cap): h_conv = min heuristic_lp over those; value_trust_depth = min{d<=cap: the PAIRED gap value_leaf_lp[d]-h_conv is BOUNDED below tol, i.e. its one-sided 95% upper bound <= tol} -- an equivalence claim, so thin or noisy evidence fails SAFE (no trust => always eligible to escalate), which is the direction that cannot cost quality. A table with no per-game record falls back to the old point test value_leaf_lp[d]-h_conv <= tol. value_no_fallback still uses the point rule. (Deep cells d>cap extend the table+crossover for the anchor but do NOT move the escalation gate; a trust_depth > search_depth is equivalent to UNSET in play.) crossover spans ALL depths.

trust_acceptance.rule: non-inferiority: accepted iff the one-sided 95% upper bound on (trustON - trustOFF) LP is at or below tol, on seeds disjoint from the matrix's. Trust is a cost lever; the claim being tested is that skipping the escalation does not cost quality.

value_fallback_crossover.rule: after escalating a value-leaf line committed at depth c, TAKE the heuristic line iff hcommitted >= take_heuristic_at_hdepth[c] (else keep the leaf). Clamp c/hcommitted to the measured [min,max] depth. Per-committed-depth (NOT a uniform offset).

provenance.note: eval_model retrained on rows dumped at SHIPPED play WITH the deck profile, so the exhaustive keep model was live. Labels are searched K=3 for every deck (a pooled dump forces one label mode). value_leaf_table/crossover here are the OLD ones until the regenerated matrix lands.
provenance.staged_shape_note: 2026-09-18: the pipeline staged this file carrying the LIVE deck's value_play {ladder:single, leaf:none}. leaf:none makes apply_leaf_policy parse the 120-tree model and then replace it with Constant(), so the staged model could never be consulted -- which is why every phase E arm came back byte-identical and the harness printed 'this arm is not engaging'. Rewritten to the shape the adoption A/B actually measured (menu shape #1).
provenance.adoption_note: ADOPTED 2026-09-18. value_trust_depth 3->4 and take_heuristic_at_hdepth[c=3] 6->3, both corrected from the generated values: phase E derived them from a run where every arm was byte-identical because the staged sidecar inherited the live deck's leaf:none, so the trust lever provably never engaged (the harness said so). The two gates are in SERIES -- fixing either alone is inert. Measured: the correction is FREE at the shipped d5b20 (1,060,000 units either way, identical play) and halves the d3b10 deficit (+0.0168 -> +0.0095 turns, 70 -> 40 worse games in 4000). trust 4 and trust 5 measured identically; 6 destroys the win (7.87M units).
